name: @ng-react/create-module
description: Spec 01 §13 B4: the create-module generator. Emits a module package carrying every blessed pattern in the spec — the §4 exports map, the contract/module split, ADR-7 thunks, C4/C5/C7/H3 providers, an L2 lifecycle with no hand-written dispose, the H2 hot block, and an R4 createTestKernel test.
